title: Heart-rate–pressure response discordance does not establish added cross-hospital CAD prediction
abstract: We tested squared discordance between log fractional exercise heart-rate and systolic-pressure responses as an added predictor of angiographic CAD. A ridge logistic baseline included flexible additive conventional exercise measures and both fractional-response components. Hungarian development included293 patients;independent institutional Long Beach VA evaluation included136,106 with disease. Brier loss worsened0.228805 to0.232397;gain-0.003593,1000 joint source-refit/target-bootstrap95%[-0.015000,0.022050]. Source5-fold CV slightly improved,but sensitivity checks changed the external sign. No added benefit is established. Protocol incompatibility,missingness,referral shift and prior historical target exposure limit confirmation. Existing public-data analysis,AI-authored,author self-checked and clean-rerun;not independent peer review.
